name: BulkGate SMS Module
description: SMS Framework gateway plugin that sends SMS through the BulkGate API.
project_description:
BulkGate SMS is module which enables connection of your Drupal Project with 3rd party service BulkGate . BulkGate provides SMS gateway for effective communication with your clients and customers.It operates in over 200 countries and regions all over the world. So, you can send texts to your contacts almost anywhere.

 This module makes use of SMS Framework which allow you to send and receive notifications, advertise your products and offers or communicate with your customers directly.

 SMS Framework

 Extensions for SMS Framework 
 Phone Verification 

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Go to admin modules on your Drupal site and enable module BulkGate SMS Module.

 Back to top 

 Setup 
 
 In Drupal SMS Framework configuration add a new Gateway using BulkGate Gateway plugin. 
 Create an account at BulkGate and enable Drupal integration in Modules and APIs section in your account. Afterwards, you will receive 'Application ID' and 'Application token'. 
 Configure BulkGate-specific settings ('Application ID' and 'Application token') in Drupal. If your credentials are correct, credit info should appear in the form after saving. 
 Enjoy happy SMSing :-).
